Subject: Brand mention & press embargo - order form attached

Hi Michael,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited to move forward. We attached the signed order form but have a couple of asks for legal before we share the announcement broadly:

- We plan to include Redwood as a named partner in our press release and use your company logo on our media landing page; please confirm any logo usage restrictions.
- We need clarity on confidentiality carveouts: our comms team needs the ability to publish a short case blurb and a screenshot of the integration that includes non-sensitive metrics. Is that acceptable?
- Proposed embargo: we are aiming for a coordinated announcement on 2026-04-20; we need approval of the final quote and logo within 48 hours of sending the final draft.

Can you loop in legal and marketing guidance (logo files, brand guidelines)? Attached: Acme_OrderForm_Draft.pdf (order form).

Cheers,

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>

Cc: James Sullivan <j.sullivan@acme-corp.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Apr 2026 09:26:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Brand mention & press embargo - order form attached

Folks — attaching an initial redline to the MSA/Order Form and a suggested short publicity clause. Summary of recommended changes below (see attached MSA_Redlines_Acme_v1.docx):

1) Confidentiality carveout (new paragraph under Section 7):
"Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Agreement, Customer may, without prior written consent, disclose the existence of this Agreement and use Redwood's name in Customer's publicly available customer list. For use of Redwood's logos, trademarks, or customer quotes/case studies (\"Publicity Materials\"), Customer must submit the proposed Publicity Materials to Redwood for review. Redwood will approve or provide reasonable redlines within five (5) business days; approval shall not be unreasonably withheld."

2) Embargo and approval timing (Order Form appendix):
"Customer may propose an announcement date. Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to provide logo/copy approval within three (3) business days of receiving the final draft; Customer acknowledges that expedited approval may not be available for logo usage on third-party sites without additional charge."

3) Screenshot / product metrics:
Add carveout language requiring Customer to remove or obfuscate any non-public PII, customer names, or revenue figures. A short neutral metric statement (e.g., \"reduced latency by X%\") is acceptable if both parties agree on the source of the metric and can validate it.

4) Misc: propose adding a one-line permission for a single customer quote (up to 250 characters) in marketing materials, subject to approval as above.

James — attached doc includes inline redline markup. If Acme needs shorter approval windows (48 hours), we can consider case-by-case escalation to the Head of Marketing, but legal prefers to keep a 3-5 business day standard to avoid missed approvals.

Monica Patel
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MSA_Redlines_Acme_v1.docx (docx)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

- As a gesture, Redwood will provide the high-res logo files and a one-time design template for Acme's media page.
- We can commit to the 2026-04-20 announcement provided we get final copy and assets by 2026-04-16 17:00 PT. If Acme needs the 48-hour turnaround, we will escalate internally but cannot guarantee for all asset types.

Next steps: Monica to send updated redline; James to confirm you can provide final copy/assets by 2026-04-16 end-of-day; I'll circulate an executed order form once legal confirms.
